title: Projection-formula coherence for a square of ringed topoi
statement:
Let $(\mathcal X,\mathcal O_X)$, $(\mathcal Y,\mathcal O_Y)$, $(\mathcal X',\mathcal O_{X'})$, and $(\mathcal Y',\mathcal O_{Y'})$ be ringed topoi, with morphisms $f:\mathcal X\to\mathcal Y$, $f':\mathcal X'\to\mathcal Y'$, $g:\mathcal Y'\to\mathcal Y$, $g':\mathcal X'\to\mathcal X$ and a specified commutation isomorphism $f g'\cong g f'$. Use derived module pullback, direct image, tensor, and their adjunctions as in [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback] and [def-weil-pbc-projection-formula-map]. For $E\in D(\mathcal O_X)$ and $Q\in D(\mathcal O_Y)$, let $\pi_f$ be the projection-formula map (the mate of counit tensor identity), and let $\operatorname{Ex}$ be the exchange map (the mate of the commutation isomorphism). The two composites
$$
Lg^*(Rf_*E\otimes^L Q)\xrightarrow{Lg^*\pi_f} Lg^*Rf_*(E\otimes^L Lf^*Q)\xrightarrow{\operatorname{Ex}} Rf'_*L(g')^*(E\otimes^L Lf^*Q)
$$
and
$$
Lg^*(Rf_*E\otimes^L Q)\cong Lg^*Rf_*E\otimes^L Lg^*Q\xrightarrow{\operatorname{Ex}\otimes1} Rf'_*L(g')^*E\otimes^L Lg^*Q\xrightarrow{\pi_{f'}}Rf'_*(L(g')^*E\otimes^L L(f')^*Lg^*Q)
$$
are equal after the canonical derived pullback tensor and composition identifications of the targets. This holds without a cartesianness assumption on the square and is natural in $E,Q$.
